load.note: v8 inherited 20; the maintainer asked for 40 on this shared host. Scoring uses the same threshold.

inputs.saved_evidence_dir: ~/.cache/e2e-skills-bench/offgen-pilot-v1 (override: OFFGEN_PILOT_V1_DIR); final.json, scores.json and every official-generator final-artifacts/<task>-official-generator-r<rep>/ tree are digest-bound in freeze.json
inputs.arm_B_input: For cell (task, rep) the saved official-generator deliverable of the same task and repetition: all files of its final-artifacts/<cell>/tests/ tree (spec files and helpers), copied into the staged project as untracked files after the baseline commit.
inputs.arms_A_and_C: Not re-run. Taken from the saved scores.json / final.json of generator-official-pilot-v1 (24 cells, 2026-10-13), verified against that pilot's report and freeze digests at analysis time.

staging: Identical to the ours arm of generator-official-pilot-v1: engine.stage(case, port, work, git=False), specs/plan.md from benchmarks/generator-official-pilot-v1/plans/<task>/, the init-agents seed tests/seed.spec.ts, git baseline commit, then the official specs copied in. The e2e-reviewer skill (skills/e2e-reviewer at base commit f83962e9, evals/ and __pycache__ excluded) is staged at /work/skill/e2e-reviewer. The playwright-test-generator skill is NOT staged.
divergences_from_original_staging: The workspace has no init-agents output (.codex/agents/*.toml, specs/README.md): no official agent is invoked, and the staging mirrors the ours arm.

The task brief ends with a review-and-fix line instead of the generation PLAN_LINE, and the arm line asks for an e2e-reviewer pass; FRAME, approvals, output schema, model, effort, timeout, container and Codex command are unchanged.
One additional per-row approval is stated in the prompt: the staged reviewer's scan.sh pinned invocation.
call: One Codex call per cell (12 total): review the untracked specs under tests/ with the 2.0.1 e2e-reviewer (Phase 0 to report, scanner per its scanner-workflow.md), then fix every P0 and every mechanically fixable P1/P2 finding in place, keeping every plan scenario, weakening no assertion, touching nothing outside tests/.
scoring: Unchanged v3 engine and v8 shared scanner, via the original pilot's helpers: clean x3, 5 seeded-fault kills, one markup refactor (primary), scanner counts, flaky clean runs, weakening text probe. B additionally records which official files the reviewer modified, removed or added.
primary: Per-cell markup-refactor survival (1 only if clean 3/3 and refactor passes). Guards: clean-all-three rate, effective fault kill, scanner P0 and P1/P2 counts.
cost_reporting: Reviewer-call seconds and parent-reported tokens are recorded separately for B; 'official generation + reviewer' totals add the saved official generation seconds and tokens of the same 12 cells (setup seconds excluded).
decision: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. No PASS/FAIL, no confidence interval, no significance claim. Three-arm view with per-task paired differences B-A and B-C.

evidence_interpretation.counts_as_suggestive: Same sign on the refactor-survival difference in at least 5 of 6 tasks with the clean-all-three rate, effective fault kill, scanner P0 total and scanner P1/P2 total not worse for the leading arm (same rule as generator-official-pilot-v1); it only motivates a full run.
evidence_interpretation.counts_as_nothing: Anything else, including a 3-3 split, ties carrying the comparison, or a single-task swing.
evidence_interpretation.weakening: Reported as the union of scanner P0 hits, weakening-text-probe hits, clean-passing specs that leave a stated-behavior fault unkilled, the reviewer_changes file list, and any manual transcript reading, each labeled by method.

stop_rules: Pause and retry when `uptime` load average (1 min) exceeds 40, up to 1800 s per wait; never more than one model call at a time.

Stop on any infrastructure error after the inherited single retry, on usage/rate limits, on disk below 4 GiB, or on any digest drift (including the saved evidence). Resume with `run --allow-live --resume --output <same path>`.
Never edit this protocol, runner, or freeze after the first scheduled call; a change needs a successor protocol.
limits: 12 cells, 6 task clusters, one repetition pair per task; arms A and C were run on a different day and in a different schedule than B, so time-of-day host load is not controlled.
B starts from A's deliverables: it measures a review-and-fix pass on those exact files, not an independent generation, and B's cells are not independent of A's.
The reviewer is instructed to fix; the 2.0.1 skill itself is a review skill. The measured effect is skill plus that instruction.
Parent JSON usage excludes child agents (reviewer verifier children, official generator children), so token totals undercount by unknown amounts.

The mechanical plan, one host/model (Codex CLI 0.159.3, gpt-5.5, medium), Playwright 1.62.0 fixture, and author-written faults with one refactor per task all carry over from generator-official-pilot-v1.
